translations.literal: Lue also for his merit in submitting allegiance was appointed Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry and Equal in Honor to the Three Dukes.
translations.idiomatic: Lue received the same ranks for his part in the submission.

sentences.zh: 頻從征討。

translations.literal: He repeatedly followed campaigns.
translations.idiomatic: He campaigned repeatedly.

sentences.zh: 建德末，位至開府儀同大將軍，封上庸縣伯。

translations.literal: At the end of Jiande he reached the rank of Grand General with an Establishment Equal to the Three Dukes and was enfeoffed as Baron of Shangyong County.
translations.idiomatic: By the end of Jiande he had risen to grand general with an open office equal to the three dukes and baron of Shangyong.

sentences.zh: 樂廣亦授車騎大將軍、儀同三司、安州刺史，封安康縣公，邑一千戶。

translations.literal: Yue Guang was also given Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry, Equal in Honor to the Three Dukes, Regional Inspector of An Province, enfeoffed as Duke of Ankang County with a fief of one thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: Yue Guang was made grand general of chariots and cavalry, equal to the three dukes, inspector of An, and duke of Ankang with one thousand households.

sentences.zh: 扶猛字宗略，上甲黃土人也。

translations.literal: Fu Meng, courtesy name Zonglüe, was a native of Huangtu in Shangjia.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Meng, courtesy name Zonglüe, came from Huangtu in Shangjia.

sentences.zh: 其種落號

translations.literal: His tribal branch was called
translations.idiomatic: His tribe was called

translations.literal: (Yue)
translations.idiomatic: (Yue) (emended: yue, called)

sentences.zh: 〔白〕獸蠻，世為渠帥。

translations.literal: 〔Bai〕 Beast Barbarians; for generations they had been chieftains.
translations.idiomatic: the Baishou Man; for generations they had been tribal chieftains.

sentences.zh: 猛，梁大同中以直後出為持節、厲鋒將軍、青州刺史，轉上庸新城二郡守、南洛北司二州刺史，封宕渠縣男。

translations.literal: Meng, in the Datong era of Liang as Direct Attendant went out as credential-holder, Fierce Edge General, and Regional Inspector of Qing Province, was transferred to Administrator of the two commanderies Shangyong and Xincheng, Regional Inspector of the two provinces Southern Luo and Northern Si, and enfeoffed as Baron of Dangqu County.
translations.idiomatic: Under Liang, in Datong, Meng served as direct attendant, then as inspector of Qing with credentials, as administrator of Shangyong and Xincheng, as inspector of Southern Luo and Northern Si, and was enfeoffed baron of Dangqu.

sentences.zh: 及侯景作亂，猛乃擁衆自守，未有所從。

translations.literal: When Hou Jing made rebellion, Meng then gathered crowds and held himself in defense, not yet siding with anyone.
translations.idiomatic: When Hou Jing rebelled, Meng gathered his followers and held his ground without joining either side.

sentences.zh: 魏大統十七年，大將軍王雄拓定魏興，猛率其衆據險為堡，時遣使微通餉饋而已。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year of Datong of Wei, Grand General Wang Xiong expanded and pacified Weixing; Meng led his masses to hold strategic points as forts, at the time sending envoys only to communicate slightly and pass provisions.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year of Datong Wang Xiong pacified Weixing; Meng held the high ground in fortified camps and only sent envoys to pass supplies.

sentences.zh: 魏廢帝元年，魏興叛，雄擊破之，猛遂以衆降。

translations.literal: In the first year of Emperor Fei of Wei, Weixing rebelled; Xiong attacked and defeated it, and Meng thereupon led his masses in surrender.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Emperor Fei, Weixing rebelled; Xiong crushed the revolt and Meng surrendered with his followers.

sentences.zh: 太祖以其世據本鄉，乃厚加撫納，授車騎大將軍、儀同三司，加散騎常侍，復爵宕渠縣男。

translations.literal: The Grand Progenitor, because his clan for generations had held their home district, generously added pacification and acceptance, appointing him Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry, Equal in Honor to the Three Dukes, additionally Regular Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry, and restoring the noble rank Baron of Dangqu County.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Progenitor treated him generously, made him grand general of chariots and cavalry with parity to the three dukes, regular attendant of the scattered cavalry, and restored his barony of Dangqu.

sentences.zh: 割二郡為羅州，以猛為刺史。

translations.literal: Two commanderies were cut off to form Luo Province, with Meng as regional inspector.
translations.idiomatic: Two commanderies were carved out as Luo province, with Meng as inspector.

sentences.zh: 令率所部千人，從開府賀若敦南討信州。

translations.literal: He was ordered to lead one thousand men of his command following Baron Heluo Dun south to campaign against Xin Province.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered to lead a thousand men under Heluo Dun against Xin.

sentences.zh: 敦令猛別道直趣白帝。

translations.literal: Dun ordered Meng by a separate route to go straight to Baidi.
translations.idiomatic: Dun sent Meng by a separate route straight to Baidi.

sentences.zh: 所由之路，人跡不通。

translations.literal: On the road he took, human tracks did not pass.
translations.idiomatic: The route he took was all but untraveled.

sentences.zh: 猛乃梯山捫葛，備歷艱阻。

translations.literal: Meng then climbed mountains and grasped vines, fully experiencing hardship and obstruction.
translations.idiomatic: Meng climbed cliffs and pulled himself up by vines through every hardship.

sentences.zh: 雪深七尺，糧運不繼，猛獎勵士卒，兼夜而行，遂至白帝城。

translations.literal: Snow was seven feet deep; grain transport did not continue; Meng encouraged the soldiers and marched also by night, and thus reached Baidi City.
translations.idiomatic: Snow lay seven feet deep and supplies failed; he urged his men on by night march until they reached Baidi.

sentences.zh: 刺史向鎮侯列陣拒猛。

translations.literal: The regional inspector Xiang Zhenhou arrayed his formations to resist Meng.
translations.idiomatic: Inspector Xiang Zhenhou drew up his line to block him.

sentences.zh: 猛與戰，破之，乘勝而進，遂入白帝城。

translations.literal: Meng fought him, defeated him, pressed the victory and advanced, and thereupon entered Baidi City.
translations.idiomatic: Meng defeated him, pressed the attack, and entered Baidi.

sentences.zh: 撫慰民夷，莫不悅附。

translations.literal: He comforted the people and barbarians; none were not pleased and attached.
translations.idiomatic: He reassured the people and the tribes, who all submitted gladly.

sentences.zh: 譙淹與官軍戰敗，率舟師浮江東下，欲歸於梁。

translations.literal: Qiao Yan was defeated in battle with the government army, led his fleet floating down the river eastward, and wished to return to Liang.
translations.idiomatic: Qiao Yan, defeated by the government army, fled downriver by boat toward Liang.

sentences.zh: 猛與敦等邀擊，破之。

translations.literal: Meng with Dun and the others intercepted and attacked and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: Meng and Dun intercepted and destroyed him.

sentences.zh: 語在《敦傳》。

translations.literal: The account is in the Biography of Dun.
translations.idiomatic: The account is given in the biography of Heluo Dun.

sentences.zh: 師還，以功進開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: When the army returned, for his merit he was advanced to Baron with an Establishment Equal to the Three Dukes.
translations.idiomatic: On the army's return he was raised to a baron with an open office equal to the three dukes.

sentences.zh: 俄而信州蠻反，猛復從賀若敦討平之。

translations.literal: Soon the barbarians of Xin Province rebelled; Meng again followed Heluo Dun and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: Soon the tribes of Xin rebelled; Meng followed Dun and pacified them.

sentences.zh: 又率水軍破蠻帥文子榮於汶陽。

translations.literal: He also led a naval force and defeated the barbarian chieftain Wen Zirong at Wenyang.
translations.idiomatic: He also led a naval force and defeated the Man chieftain Wen Zirong at Wenyang.

sentences.zh: 進爵臨江縣公，增邑一千戶。

translations.literal: His noble rank was advanced to Duke of Linjiang County, with fief households increased by one thousand.
translations.idiomatic: He was raised to duke of Linjiang with an added thousand households.

sentences.zh: 武成中，陳將侯瑱等逼湘州，又從賀若敦赴救，除武州刺史。

translations.literal: In Wucheng, the Chen generals Hou Zhen and others pressed Xiang Province; he again followed Heluo Dun to the relief and was appointed Regional Inspector of Wu Province.
translations.idiomatic: During Wucheng, when Chen generals including Hou Zhen pressed Xiang, he followed Dun to the relief and was made inspector of Wu.

sentences.zh: 後隨敦自拔還，復為羅州刺史。

translations.literal: Later he followed Dun in breaking out and returning, and again became Regional Inspector of Luo Province.
translations.idiomatic: Later he broke out with Dun and returned, and again became inspector of Luo.

sentences.zh: 保定三年，轉綏州刺史，從衛公直援陳將華皎。

translations.literal: In the third year of Baoding he was transferred to Regional Inspector of Sui Province and followed Duke of Wei Zhi in relieving the Chen general Hua Jiao.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Baoding he was transferred to Sui and followed Duke of Wei Zhi to aid the Chen general Hua Jiao.

sentences.zh: 時大軍不利，唯猛所部獨全。

translations.literal: At the time the main army was unfavorable; only Meng's command alone remained intact.
translations.idiomatic: The main army fared badly, but Meng's detachment alone came through intact.

sentences.zh: 又從田弘破漢南諸蠻，前後十餘戰，每有功。

translations.literal: He also followed Tian Hong in defeating the various barbarians south of Han, more than ten battles in all, each time with merit.
translations.idiomatic: He also followed Tian Hong in more than ten victories over the Man south of Han.

sentences.zh: 進位大將軍。

translations.literal: He was advanced to Grand General.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to grand general.

sentences.zh: 後以疾卒。

translations.literal: Later he died of illness.
translations.idiomatic: He later died of illness.

sentences.zh: 陽雄字元略，上洛邑陽人也。

translations.literal: Yang Xiong, courtesy name Yuanlüe, was a native of Yiyang in Shangluo.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Xiong, courtesy name Yuanlüe, came from Yiyang in Shangluo.

sentences.zh: 世為豪族。

translations.literal: For generations they had been a powerful clan.
translations.idiomatic: His family had long been a powerful local clan.

sentences.zh: 祖斌，上庸太守。

translations.literal: His grandfather Bin was Administrator of Shangyong.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Bin had been administrator of Shangyong.

sentences.zh: 父猛，魏正光中，万俟醜奴作亂關右，朝廷以猛商洛首望，乃擢為襄威將軍、大谷鎮將，帶胡城令，以禦醜奴。

translations.literal: His father Meng, in the Zhenguang era of Wei when Moqi Chounu made disorder in Guanxi, the court because Meng was the leading figure of Shang and Luo promoted him to Majestic Might General and garrison commander of Dagu, concurrently Magistrate of Hucheng, to resist Chounu.
translations.idiomatic: His father Meng, when Moqi Chounu ravaged Guanxi in the Zhenguang era, was made majestic might general and garrison commander of Dagu with concurrent magistracy of Hucheng to resist him.

sentences.zh: 及元顥入洛，魏孝莊帝度河，范陽王誨脫身投猛，猛保藏之。

translations.literal: When Yuan Hao entered Luoyang, Emperor Xiaozhuang of Wei crossed the river; the Prince of Fanyang Hui escaped his body and threw himself on Meng, and Meng protected and concealed him.
translations.idiomatic: When Yuan Hao took Luoyang, Emperor Xiaozhuang fled across the river; Prince of Fanyang Hui sought refuge with Meng, who sheltered him.

sentences.zh: 及孝莊反正，由是知名。

translations.literal: When Xiaozhuang restored the correct order, because of this he became known.
translations.idiomatic: When Xiaozhuang was restored to the throne, Meng became famous for this.

sentences.zh: 俄而廣陵王恭偽瘖疾，復來歸猛，猛亦深相保護。

translations.literal: Soon the Prince of Guangling Gong feigned dumbness and illness and again came to return to Meng; Meng also deeply protected him.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Prince of Guangling Gong, feigning illness, came to Meng again, and Meng protected him as before.

sentences.zh: 魏孝武卽位，甚嘉之，授征虜將軍，行河北郡守，尋轉安西將軍、華山郡守。

translations.literal: When Emperor Xiaowu took the throne he greatly praised this and appointed him General Who Conquers the Barbarians, acting Administrator of Hebei Commandery, and soon transferred to General Who Pacifies the West and Administrator of Huashan Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xiaowu acceded he rewarded Meng with general who conquers the barbarians and acting administrator of Hebei, then general who pacifies the west and administrator of Huashan.

sentences.zh: 頻典

translations.literal: He repeatedly held office in
translations.idiomatic: He repeatedly governed

translations.literal: (three)
translations.idiomatic: (three) (emended: san, three)

sentences.zh: 郡，頗有聲績。

translations.literal: commanderies and had considerable reputation and achievement.
translations.idiomatic: commanderies and won a solid reputation.

sentences.zh: 及孝武西遷，猛率所領，移鎮潼關。

translations.literal: When Xiaowu moved west, Meng led those under his command and transferred his garrison to Tong Pass.
translations.idiomatic: When Xiaowu fled west, Meng moved his garrison to Tong Pass.

sentences.zh: 封郃陽縣伯，邑七百戶。

translations.literal: He was enfeoffed as Baron of Heyang County with a fief of seven hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: He was enfeoffed baron of Heyang with seven hundred households.

sentences.zh: 俄而潼關不守，猛於善渚谷立柵，收集義徒。

translations.literal: Soon Tong Pass could not be held; Meng established a stockade at Shanzu Valley and gathered righteous followers.
translations.idiomatic: When Tong Pass fell, Meng built a stockade at Shanzu Valley and gathered loyal volunteers.

sentences.zh: 授征東將軍、揚州刺史、大都督、武衛將軍，仍鎮善渚。

translations.literal: He was appointed General Who Campaigns East, Regional Inspector of Yang Province, Chief Area Commander, and Defender General, still garrisoning Shanzu.
translations.idiomatic: He was made general who campaigns east, inspector of Yang, chief area commander, and defender general, still at Shanzu.

sentences.zh: 大統三年，為竇泰所襲，猛脫身得免。

translations.literal: In the third year of Datong he was attacked by Dou Tai and Meng escaped with his body intact.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Datong Dou Tai attacked him; Meng escaped alive.

sentences.zh: 太祖以衆寡不敵，弗之責也。

translations.literal: The Grand Progenitor, because their numbers were few and could not match the enemy, did not blame him.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Progenitor did not blame him, seeing he had been outnumbered.

sentences.zh: 仍配兵千人，守牛尾堡。

translations.literal: He was still assigned one thousand troops to guard Niwei Fort.
translations.idiomatic: He was given another thousand men to hold Niwei fort.

sentences.zh: 尋而太祖擒竇泰，猛亦別獲東魏弘農郡守淳于業。

translations.literal: Soon the Grand Progenitor captured Dou Tai; Meng also separately captured Eastern Wei's Administrator of Hongnong Commandery Chunyu Ye.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Grand Progenitor captured Dou Tai; Meng separately captured Eastern Wei's Hongnong administrator Chunyu Ye.

sentences.zh: 後以疾卒。

translations.literal: Later he died of illness.
translations.idiomatic: He later died of illness.

sentences.zh: 贈華、洛、揚三州刺史。

translations.literal: He was posthumously given Regional Inspector of the three provinces Hua, Luo, and Yang.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously made inspector of Hua, Luo, and Yang.

sentences.zh: 雄起家奉朝請，累遷至都督、直後、明威將軍、積射將軍。

translations.literal: Xiong began his career as Court Gentleman for the Imperial Audience, was repeatedly promoted to area commander, direct attendant, Bright Might General, and Accumulated Shooter General.
translations.idiomatic: Xiong entered service as court gentleman and rose through area commander, direct attendant, bright might general, and accumulated shooter general.

sentences.zh: 從于謹攻盤豆柵，復從李遠經沙苑陣，並力戰有功。

translations.literal: He followed Yu Jin in attacking the Pandou stockade, again followed Li Yuan through the Shayuan formation, and in each fought strenuously with merit.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Yu Jin against Pandou, fought with Li Yuan at Shayuan, and distinguished himself in both.

sentences.zh: 封安平縣侯，邑八百戶，加冠軍將軍、中散大夫，賞賜甚厚。

translations.literal: He was enfeoffed as Marquis of Ping'an County with a fief of eight hundred households, additionally made Champion General and Central Scattered Grand Master, with rewards very thick.
translations.idiomatic: He was enfeoffed marquis of Ping'an with eight hundred households, made champion general and central scattered grand master, and richly rewarded.

sentences.zh: 後入洛陽，戰河橋，解玉壁圍，迎高仲密，援侯景，並預有戰功。

translations.literal: Later he entered Luoyang, fought at Heqiao, relieved the siege of Yubi, welcomed Gao Zhongmi, and aided Hou Jing—each time sharing in battle merit.
translations.idiomatic: He fought at Luoyang, Heqiao, and Yubi, welcomed Gao Zhongmi, and aided Hou Jing, earning merit in each.

sentences.zh: 前後增邑四百五十戶，世襲邑陽郡守。

translations.literal: His fief was increased by four hundred fifty households in all, with hereditary succession as Administrator of Yiyang Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: His fief grew by four hundred fifty households, with the Yiyang magistracy made hereditary.

sentences.zh: 從大將軍宇文虯攻克上津，遷通直散騎常侍、大都督，進儀同三司。

translations.literal: Following Grand General Yuwen Zhao in taking Shangjin, he was transferred to Direct Regular Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry and Chief Area Commander, advanced to Equal in Honor to the Three Dukes.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Yuwen Zhao in taking Shangjin, became direct regular attendant of the scattered cavalry and chief area commander, and was raised to parity with the three dukes.

sentences.zh: 陳將侯方兒、潘純陀寇江陵，雄從豆盧寧擊走之。

translations.literal: The Chen generals Hou Fang'er and Pan Chuntuo raided Jiangling; Xiong followed Doulu Ning and drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: When Chen generals Hou Fang'er and Pan Chuntuo raided Jiangling, Xiong followed Doulu Ning and drove them off.

sentences.zh: 除洵州刺史。

translations.literal: He was appointed Regional Inspector of Xun Province.
translations.idiomatic: He was made inspector of Xun.

sentences.zh: 俗雜賨、渝，民多輕猾。

translations.literal: The customs mixed Cong and Yu; the people were mostly light and crafty.
translations.idiomatic: The region mixed Cong and Yu peoples and its folk were crafty.

sentences.zh: 雄威惠相濟，夷夏安之。

translations.literal: Xiong with authority and kindness together brought peace to both barbarians and Chinese.
translations.idiomatic: Xiong combined firmness with kindness and brought peace to Chinese and tribes alike.

sentences.zh: 蠻帥文子榮竊據荊州之汶陽郡，又侵陷南郡之當陽、臨沮等數縣。

translations.literal: The barbarian chieftain Wen Zirong secretly held Jing Province's Wenyang Commandery and also invaded and seized several counties of Nan Commandery including Dangyang and Linju.
translations.idiomatic: The Man chieftain Wen Zirong held Wenyang in Jing and raided Dangyang, Linju, and other counties in Nan.

sentences.zh: 詔遣開府賀若敦、潘招等討平之。

translations.literal: An edict sent Baron Heluo Dun, Pan Zhao, and others to campaign and pacify them.
translations.idiomatic: Baron Heluo Dun and Pan Zhao were sent to suppress him.

sentences.zh: 卽以其地置平州，以雄為刺史。

translations.literal: Thereupon on that territory Ping Province was established, with Xiong as regional inspector.
translations.idiomatic: That territory was then made Ping province, with Xiong as inspector.

sentences.zh: 進爵玉城縣公，增邑通前一千六百戶，加驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: His noble rank was advanced to Duke of Yucheng County, with fief households increased together with earlier holdings to one thousand six hundred, additionally made General of Agile Cavalry and Baron with an Establishment Equal to the Three Dukes.
translations.idiomatic: He was raised to duke of Yucheng with sixteen hundred households in all, and made general of agile cavalry with an open office equal to the three dukes.

sentences.zh: 時寇亂之後，戶多逃散，雄在所慰撫，民並安輯。

translations.literal: At the time after the raids and disorder, households had mostly fled and scattered; wherever Xiong was he comforted and pacified, and the people were all settled and ordered.
translations.idiomatic: After the wars many households had fled; wherever Xiong governed he brought people back and restored order.

sentences.zh: 徵為載師中大夫，遷西寧州總管，以疾不拜。

translations.literal: He was summoned as Grand Master of the Imperial Carriages, transferred to headquarters commander of Xining Province, but because of illness did not accept.
translations.idiomatic: He was summoned as grand master of the imperial carriages and offered Xining headquarters command, but declined because of illness.

sentences.zh: 除通洛防主。

translations.literal: He was appointed defense commander of Tongluo.
translations.idiomatic: He was made defense commander of Tongluo.

sentences.zh: 席固字子堅，其先安定人也。

translations.literal: Xi Gu, courtesy name Zijian, his ancestors were natives of Anding.
translations.idiomatic: Xi Gu, courtesy name Zijian, was descended from Anding.

sentences.zh: 高祖衡，因後秦之亂，寓居於襄陽。

translations.literal: His high ancestor Heng, because of the disorder of Later Qin, sojourned at Xiangyang.
translations.idiomatic: His ancestor Heng, in the turmoil of Later Qin, settled at Xiangyang.

sentences.zh: 仕晉，為建威將軍，遂為襄陽著姓。

translations.literal: He served Jin as Majestic Might General and thus became a noted surname of Xiangyang.
translations.idiomatic: He served Jin as majestic might general, and the family became a leading clan of Xiangyang.

sentences.zh: 固少有遠志，內明敏而外質朴。

translations.literal: Gu in youth had far-reaching aims, inwardly bright and keen yet outwardly plain and simple.
translations.idiomatic: Gu was ambitious from youth—sharp within, plain without.

sentences.zh: 梁大同中，為齊興郡守。

translations.literal: In the Datong era of Liang he was Administrator of Qixing Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: In Liang's Datong era he was administrator of Qixing.

sentences.zh: 屬侯景渡江，梁室大亂，固久居郡職，士多附之，遂有親兵千餘人。

translations.literal: When Hou Jing crossed the river the Liang house fell into great disorder; Gu long held office in the commandery, many scholars attached to him, and he thereupon had personal troops of more than a thousand men.
translations.idiomatic: When Hou Jing crossed the Yangzi and the Liang court collapsed, Gu had long held Qixing; many men rallied to him, and he commanded more than a thousand troops.

sentences.zh: 梁元帝嗣位江陵，遷興州刺史。

translations.literal: When Emperor Yuan of Liang succeeded at Jiangling he was transferred to Regional Inspector of Xing Province.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Yuan acceded at Jiangling, Gu was made inspector of Xing.

sentences.zh: 於是軍民慕從者，至五千餘人。

translations.literal: Thereupon soldiers and civilians who admired and followed him reached more than five thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Soldiers and civilians who followed him now numbered more than five thousand.

sentences.zh: 固遂欲自據一州，以觀時變。

translations.literal: Gu then wished to hold a province for himself and observe how the times changed.
translations.idiomatic: Gu then meant to hold his province and watch how events unfolded.

sentences.zh: 後懼王師進討，方圖內屬。

translations.literal: Later fearing the royal army would advance to attack, he then planned to submit inward.
translations.idiomatic: Later, fearing an imperial attack, he decided to submit.

sentences.zh: 密謂其腹心曰：「今梁氏失政，揚都覆沒，湘東不能復讎雪恥，而骨肉相殘。

translations.literal: He secretly told his close confidants: "Now the Liang house has lost government; Yangdu is overthrown; the Prince of Xiangdong cannot avenge and wipe away shame, yet flesh and blood attack one another.
translations.idiomatic: He told his confidants in secret, "The Liang regime has failed, the capital is lost, and the princes slaughter one another instead of avenging the realm.

sentences.zh: 宇文丞相剏啟霸基，招攜以禮。

translations.literal: Chief Minister Yuwen has founded a hegemonic base and gathers men with courtesy.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Minister Yuwen is building a new order and receives men with courtesy.

sentences.zh: 吾欲決意歸之，與卿等共圖富貴。

translations.literal: I wish to resolve to submit to him and with you gentlemen together seek wealth and honor.
translations.idiomatic: I mean to submit to him and share rank and riches with you.

sentences.zh: 」左右聞固言，未有應者。

translations.literal: " Those beside him who heard Gu's words at first had none who responded.
translations.idiomatic: " His followers at first said nothing.

sentences.zh: 固更諭以禍福，諸人然後同之。

translations.literal: Gu again explained advantage and harm, and the others then agreed with him.
translations.idiomatic: When he explained the stakes, they agreed.

sentences.zh: 魏大統十六年，以地來附。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Datong of Wei he submitted his territory in allegiance.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year of Datong he submitted his territory.

sentences.zh: 是時太祖方欲南取江陵，西定蜀、漢，聞固之至，甚禮遇之。

translations.literal: At the time the Grand Progenitor was just about to take Jiangling south and pacify Shu and Han west; hearing of Gu's arrival he treated him with great courtesy.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Progenitor was then planning to take Jiangling and pacify Shu and Han; he received Gu with great honor.

sentences.zh: 乃遣使就拜使持節、驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司、大都督、侍中、豐州刺史，封新豐縣公，邑二千戶。

translations.literal: He then sent envoys to appoint him on the spot Envoy Holding Credentials, General of Agile Cavalry, Baron with an Establishment Equal to the Three Dukes, Chief Area Commander, Palace Attendant, Regional Inspector of Feng Province, enfeoffed as Duke of Xinfeng County with a fief of two thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys at once made him envoy with credentials, general of agile cavalry, baron equal to the three dukes, chief area commander, palace attendant, inspector of Feng, and duke of Xinfeng with two thousand households.

sentences.zh: 後轉湖州刺史。

translations.literal: Later he was transferred to Regional Inspector of Hu Province.
translations.idiomatic: He was later transferred to inspector of Hu.

sentences.zh: 固以未經朝謁，遂蒙榮授，心不自安，啟求入覲。

translations.literal: Gu because he had not yet attended court yet received glorious appointment felt uneasy in heart and memorialized requesting to enter and have audience.
translations.idiomatic: Having never attended court, he felt uneasy at such honors and asked to pay his respects in person.

sentences.zh: 太祖許之。

translations.literal: The Grand Progenitor approved it.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Progenitor agreed.

sentences.zh: 及固至，太祖與之歡醼，賞賜甚厚。

translations.literal: When Gu arrived the Grand Progenitor feasted and drank merrily with him and rewarded him very generously.
translations.idiomatic: When Gu arrived, Grand Progenitor feasted with him and gave him lavish gifts.

sentences.zh: 進爵靜安郡公，增邑並前三千三百戶。

translations.literal: His noble rank was advanced to Duke of Jing'an Commandery, with fief households increased together with earlier holdings to three thousand three hundred.
translations.idiomatic: He was raised to duke of Jing'an, his fief increased to thirty-three hundred households in all.

sentences.zh: 尋拜昌歸憲三州諸軍事、昌州刺史。

translations.literal: Soon he was appointed commander-in-chief of military affairs of the three provinces Chang, Gui, and Xian, and Regional Inspector of Chang Province.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was made commander of Chang, Gui, and Xian and inspector of Chang.

sentences.zh: 固居家孝友，為州里所稱，蒞官之處，頗有聲績。

translations.literal: Gu at home was filial and friendly and was praised by his province and district; in the places he held office he had considerable reputation and achievement.
translations.idiomatic: At home he was filial and brotherly and praised locally; in office he governed well.

sentences.zh: 保定四年，卒於州，時年六十一。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Baoding he died in the province, aged sixty-one.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Baoding he died in office at sixty-one.

sentences.zh: 贈大將軍、襄唐豐郢復五州刺史，諡曰肅。

translations.literal: He was posthumously given Grand General and Regional Inspector of the five provinces Xiang, Tang, Feng, Ying, and Fu, posthumous title Su.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously made grand general and inspector of Xiang, Tang, Feng, Ying, and Fu, with the posthumous name Su.

sentences.zh: 仍勅襄州賜其墓田。

translations.literal: An edict still ordered Xiang Province to grant his tomb fields.
translations.idiomatic: The throne also ordered Xiang province to grant land for his tomb.

sentences.zh: 子世雅嗣。

translations.literal: His son Shiya succeeded him.
translations.idiomatic: His son Shiya inherited the line.

sentences.zh: 世雅字彥文。

translations.literal: Shiya, courtesy name Yanwen.
translations.idiomatic: Shiya, courtesy name Yanwen.

sentences.zh: 性方正，少以孝聞。

translations.literal: His nature was upright and square; in youth he was known for filial piety.
translations.idiomatic: He was upright by nature and known for filial piety from youth.

sentences.zh: 初以固功，授車騎大將軍、儀同三司，除贊城郡守。

translations.literal: At first because of Gu's merit he was appointed Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry and Equal in Honor to the Three Dukes, and appointed Administrator of Zancheng Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: At first, for Gu's merit, he was made grand general of chariots and cavalry, equal to the three dukes, and administrator of Zancheng.

sentences.zh: 累遷開府儀同三司、順直二州刺史。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to Baron with an Establishment Equal to the Three Dukes and Regional Inspector of the two provinces Shun and Zhi.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to a baron equal to the three dukes and inspector of Shun and Zhi.

sentences.zh: 大象末，位至大將軍。

translations.literal: At the end of Datong he reached the rank of Grand General.
translations.idiomatic: By the end of Datong he had risen to grand general.

sentences.zh: 世雅弟世英，亦以固功授儀同三司。

translations.literal: Shiya's younger brother Shiying also for Gu's merit was appointed Equal in Honor to the Three Dukes.
translations.idiomatic: Gu's younger son Shiying received parity with the three dukes for the same service.

sentences.zh: 後至上開府儀同大將軍。

translations.literal: Later he reached Senior Grand General with an Establishment Equal to the Three Dukes.
translations.idiomatic: He later rose to senior grand general with an open office equal to the three dukes.

sentences.zh: 任果字靜鸞，南安人也。

translations.literal: Ren Guo, courtesy name Jingluan, was a native of Nan'an.
translations.idiomatic: Ren Guo, courtesy name Jingluan, came from Nan'an.

sentences.zh: 世為方隅豪族，仕於江左。

translations.literal: For generations they had been a powerful clan of the border region, serving in the Jiang left.
translations.idiomatic: For generations his clan had been powerful in the borderlands and had served the southern dynasties.

sentences.zh: 祖安東，梁益州別駕、新巴郡守、閬中伯。

translations.literal: His grandfather Andong was Vice Director of Yi Province in Liang, Administrator of Xinba Commandery, and Baron of Langzhong.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Andong had been Liang's vice director of Yi, administrator of Xinba, and baron of Langzhong.

sentences.zh: 父褒，龍驤將軍、新巴南安廣漢三郡守、沙州刺史、新巴縣公。

translations.literal: His father Bao was General of the Dragon Cavalry, Administrator of the three commanderies Xinba, Nan'an, and Guanghan, Regional Inspector of Sha Province, and Duke of Xinba County.
translations.idiomatic: His father Bao had been general of the dragon cavalry, administrator of Xinba, Nan'an, and Guanghan, inspector of Sha, and duke of Xinba.

sentences.zh: 及尉遲迥伐蜀，果時在京師，乃遣其弟岱及子悛從軍。

translations.literal: When Yu Chi Jiong campaigned against Shu, Guo was then at the capital; he sent his younger brother Dai and his son Juan to follow the army.
translations.idiomatic: When Yu Chi Jiong invaded Shu, Guo was at the capital and sent his brother Dai and son Juan with the army.

sentences.zh: 太祖以益州未下，復令果乘傳歸南安，率鄉兵二千人，從迥征蜀。

translations.literal: The Grand Progenitor, because Yi Province was not yet taken, again ordered Guo to travel by post to return to Nan'an, lead two thousand local troops, and follow Jiong in campaigning against Shu.
translations.idiomatic: Because Yi was not yet taken, Grand Progenitor sent Guo home to Nan'an to raise two thousand local troops and join Jiong.

sentences.zh: 尋進授驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: Soon he was advanced to General of Agile Cavalry and Baron with an Establishment Equal to the Three Dukes.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was made general of agile cavalry with an open office equal to the three dukes.

sentences.zh: 蕭紀遣趙拔扈等率衆三萬來援成都，果從大軍擊破之。

translations.literal: Xiao Ji sent Zhao Bahu and others to lead thirty thousand men to relieve Chengdu; Guo with the main army defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Ji sent Zhao Bahu with thirty thousand men to relieve Chengdu; Guo helped the main army defeat them.

sentences.zh: 及成都平，除始州刺史。

translations.literal: When Chengdu was pacified he was appointed Regional Inspector of Shi Province.
translations.idiomatic: When Chengdu fell he was made inspector of Shi.

sentences.zh: 在任未久，果請入朝，太祖許之。

translations.literal: While in office not long, Guo requested to enter court and the Grand Progenitor approved it.
translations.idiomatic: He had not been long in office when he asked to go to court, and Grand Progenitor agreed.

sentences.zh: 以其方隅首望，早立忠節，乃進爵安樂郡公，賜以鐵券，聽世相傳襲。

translations.literal: Because he was the leading figure of his border region and had early established loyal integrity, his rank was advanced to Duke of Anle Commandery, he was granted an iron certificate, and permission was given for hereditary succession generation after generation.
translations.idiomatic: As the leading man of his region and an early loyalist, he was raised to duke of Anle, given an iron certificate, and allowed hereditary succession.

sentences.zh: 並賜路車、駟馬及儀衛等以光寵之。

translations.literal: He was also bestowed a state carriage, four-horse team, and guards and insignia and the rest to glorify the favor.
translations.idiomatic: He was also given a state carriage, a team of four horses, guards, and other marks of honor.

sentences.zh: 尋為刺客所害，時年五十六。

translations.literal: Soon he was killed by assassins, aged fifty-six.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he was killed by assassins at fifty-six.

sentences.zh: 史臣曰：古人稱仁義豈有常，蹈之則為君子，背之則為小人，信矣。

translations.literal: The historiographer says: The ancients said that benevolence and righteousness have no constancy—tread them and one becomes a gentleman, turn one's back and one becomes a petty man—how true!
translations.idiomatic: The historian writes: The ancients said benevolence and righteousness have no fixed form—follow them and you are a gentleman, abandon them and you are a petty man. How true that is.

sentences.zh: 泉企長自山谷，素無月旦之譽，而臨難慷慨，有人臣之節，豈非蹈仁義歟。

translations.literal: Quan Qi grew up himself in mountain valleys and plainly had no reputation for monthly judging of character, yet facing hardship he was generous and stern and had the integrity of a minister—was this not treading benevolence and righteousness?
translations.idiomatic: Quan Qi was raised in the hills without fame for refined judgment, yet in crisis he showed a subject's integrity—was that not walking the path of benevolence and righteousness?

sentences.zh: 元禮、仲遵聿遵其志，卒成功業，庶乎克負荷矣。

translations.literal: Yuanli and Zhongzun followed his will and at last accomplished their enterprise—perhaps they were able to bear the burden.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanli and Zhongzun kept their father's charge and finished what he began—they did, it seems, bear the burden after all.

sentences.zh: 李遷哲、楊乾運、席固之徒，屬方隅擾攘，咸翻然而委質，遂享爵位，以保終始。

translations.literal: Men such as Li Qianzhe, Yang Ganyun, and Xi Gu, amid border turmoil, all turned about and submitted their substance, and thus enjoyed noble ranks, preserving themselves to the end.
translations.idiomatic: Li Qianzhe, Yang Ganyun, Xi Gu, and others, in troubled borderlands, all turned in time to submit, kept their ranks, and died in honor.

sentences.zh: 觀遷哲之對太祖，有尚義之辭；

translations.literal: Consider Qianzhe's reply to the Grand Progenitor—there were words honoring righteousness;
translations.idiomatic: Qianzhe's answer to Grand Progenitor had the ring of honor;

sentences.zh: 乾運受任武陵，乖事人之道。

translations.literal: Ganyun received appointment from Wuling yet deviated from the way of serving others.
translations.idiomatic: Ganyun served Wuling yet failed the way of a true servant.

sentences.zh: 若乃校長短，比優劣，故不可同年而語矣。

translations.literal: If one compares their lengths and shortcomings and weighs their excellence and inferiority, they truly cannot be spoken of in the same year.
translations.idiomatic: Measured against one another, they cannot be ranked alike.

sentences.zh: 陽雄任兼文武，聲著中外，抑亦志能之士乎。

translations.literal: Yang Xiong combined civil and military roles and his fame resounded within and without—perhaps he too was a man of will and capacity.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Xiong united civil and military fame at court and on the frontier—he too was surely a man of real ability.

sentences.zh: 全文以中華書局、一九七一年十一月版《周書》為本校。

translations.literal: The full text has been collated against the Zhonghua Shuju edition of the Book of Zhou (November 1971).
translations.idiomatic: The full text has been collated against the November 1971 Zhonghua Shuju edition of the Book of Zhou.
